fieldValues.title: D4 Living document library
fieldValues.summary: Document content and definitions evolve through visible revision, migration and compatibility practices; reusable content remains linked to its semantic context.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need to revise content, evolve document definitions and reuse shared pieces without obscuring what changed or breaking existing documents.

## Semantic Adds

- field-level revision and provenance
- definition migration guidance
- reusable content and lineage relations

## Blueprint Adds

- revision-aware editing
- migration and reuse review facets

## Does Not Introduce

- silent type migration
- immutable website configuration
- cross-repository merge semantics

## Activation Trigger

A group maintains a document library long enough that shared definitions and previously published content must change safely.

## Research

- problem-index/07-field-records/field-versioning.md: Revision chains make individual semantic changes auditable and safely restorable.
